notes: The reference's hero tree. Six plates, drooping tips, a golden-angle turn between courses so no two rims line up. `bare` leaves a sixth of the trunk clear at the bottom, which is what lets the eye read a trunk at all — the greybox's cones met the ground and the tree had no legs. LOD switches authored: the derived ladder would run LOD0 out to 250 m on a 16 m tree.

rules.placement: Hero conifer for woodland canopy and meadow copses; leave clear trunk at the base so it reads as a tree with legs.
rules.avoid: Avoid desert, coast, and wetland flats.
